scope: Segment 153 3-field TLV wrapper and 6-table Network Token Data sub-segment catalog

rules.title: Segment 153 contains Network Token Data for the transaction; may hold multiple TLV-encoded sub-segments (standard sub-segment type, length, value)
Segment Type fixed 153, Segment Length 3 digits (includes Segment Type's length), both Device-sourced

Network Token Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, cataloged as 6 fixed sub-tables: 001 (Network Token, 013-018 bytes), 002 (Expiration Date, fixed 004), 003 (Provisional Fee Indicator, fixed 001), 004 (Input Indicator, fixed 001), 005 (Eligible Indicator, fixed 001), 006 (PAN Indicator, fixed 001)
rules.note: Note element number 239 is shared with Segments 145/146's Enhanced Fleet Data — same cross-segment element reuse pattern already documented for Element 118.
